To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

hybrid entrepreneurs are significantly more innovative than entrepreneurs with full-time employment in their start-up and that this is due to the fact that hybrid entrepreneurs experiment with their business idea before they leave their paid employment.
hybrid entrepreneurs are more likely to have an innovative business idea and to have a higher growth potential.
hybrid entrepreneurs are more likely to start innovative businesses and to grow their businesses.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how entrepreneurs can reduce the risk associated with the development of innovative business ideas.
a specific form of entrepreneurship that is often neglected by research and public policy making.
how entrepreneurs manage the risk associated with innovative business ideas.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the hybrid entrepreneurship is a form of entrepreneurship that can be seen as an experiment with innovative business ideas.
the current neglect by policy makers of hybrid entrepreneurs and their innovative business ideas runs counter to their goal of fostering innovative entrepreneurship.
hybrid entrepreneurship is a viable way for entrepreneurs to mitigate risk associated with innovation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
hybrid entrepreneurship is a form of entrepreneurship that allows for the experimentation with innovative business ideas.
hybrid entrepreneurship can be considered as an important source for innovative start ups and thus a valuable asset for regional economies.
the more innovative the start-up idea the more likely is the hybrid entrepreneurship.
The main takeaway from our work is that
policy makers should not only support full-time entrepreneurs but also hybrid entrepreneurs.
policy makers should not only focus on the creation of new businesses, but also on the creation of hybrid entrepreneurship, as the latter is more likely to result in innovative new ventures.
hybrid entrepreneurs can be seen as a valuable source of innovation and thus should not be neglected.
